summary: Near Confidential Intents provides confidential accounts, transfers and swaps on FAR, a permissioned private NEAR network accessed through near.com. Internal activity is documented as hidden from public observers; deposits and withdrawals use public backing and a mandatory bridge. The documented exit requires operator cooperation. Public core pause and registered-version rollback powers are established, while private operator visibility, deployed software correspondence and complete operational history remain unverified. This manual contributor draft has 21 researched unknowns; missing evidence is not a demonstrated vulnerability.
